identity.name: Black Bay Chrono
identity.one_liner: Tudor's column-wheel chronograph, built on a movement architecture co-developed with Breitling, with a white 'panda' dial and contrasting black chronograph subdials.

narrative.story: The Black Bay Chrono runs caliber MT5813, a movement built on the architecture Tudor co-developed with Breitling, which uses the same base for its own B01 chronograph. The panda-dial version pairs a white dial with black counters and a black aluminum tachymeter bezel, a color scheme that predates both brands and has been common on chronographs since the 1960s.
narrative.collector_notes: Buyers checking movement authenticity look for the column-wheel actuation and vertical clutch shared with the Breitling B01, which is what separates this from Tudor's earlier ETA/Valjoux-based chronographs.
